name: sample-corpus
description: Twelve questions answerable from corpus/. Two are exact-identifier questions carrying an `expect` list, which turns them into a string-matchable correctness gate on retrieval.

questions.question: Which collection metadata key selects ChromaDB's distance function, and which value does this pipeline set it to?
Which Ollama request field controls how long a model stays loaded after a request, and what value does this pipeline use?
Why does the chunker treat a fenced code block as indivisible, and what does it do when a single fenced block exceeds the character budget?
Describe the three tiers of the chunking strategy and explain why splitting on markdown headers is preferred over a fixed width.
Under what circumstances is a chunk allowed to exceed the character budget, and what is the reasoning behind allowing it?
What is the difference between reliability and accuracy in evaluating a RAG system, and why does reliability deserve its own harness?
How can measuring only accuracy hide an unreliable model, and what bias does that introduce?
Why is dense vector retrieval weak on queries whose answer is a literal identifier, and what kind of retrieval has the opposite failure profile?
What happens to an existing vector index when the embedding model changes, and what two design rules follow from that?
Why is configuring a model's full advertised context window expensive, and how should a working value be chosen instead?
What is the purpose of a hard cap on generated tokens, and why is it a liveness guarantee rather than a quality setting?
How does retrieval-augmented generation differ from fine-tuning as a way of giving a model new knowledge, and why must retrieval and generation be evaluated separately?
